information: Join us for the LA leg of the West Coast Cubing Tour! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzA0OTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--310605b25b0ecf790ae7a5eddc8b532d6493cd85/WCCT2.PNG) This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCTLosAngeles2025#43202-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1NKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--928aebc1c75f745abb0b80097896dba5180958fd/image.png) This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels. ### UCLA Students If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCTLosAngeles2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
